concept.title: Selectors
concept.shortdesc: A selector tells CSSMedia which element or elements in the XML file a CSS rule applies to. A rule has a selector followed by braces. Inside the braces, write declarations that set property values:

conbody.p: Here, chapter is the selector and color: navy; is a declaration. CSSMedia reads XML names and attributes as data. It does not assign vocabulary-specific meanings to them.
The guides are grouped by selector type and matching behavior:

ul.li: Selector reference: a compact reference to the selector forms and their PDF behavior.
Basic selectors and namespaces: element names, IDs, classes, attributes and XML namespaces.
Combinators: selecting elements by their relationship to other elements.
Pseudo-classes: structural tests, selector logic, language and other states.
Pseudo-elements: selecting generated content, text parts and other special targets.
Specificity: how selectors help resolve competing declarations.
